scope: Eleven missing Vandenberg protest defendants with confirmed multi-day US custody; nine activists and two journalists. Preserve all existing profiles.

roster-july.label: Associated Press report reproduced in Berkeley Daily Planet July 20, 2001 issue: names and nationalities supplied by Greenpeace spokeswoman Carol Gregory. Indexed text reviewed; direct download failed.

roster-january.label: Erica Werner/AP, January 8, 2002, Berkeley Daily Planet January 10 issue: named defendants including Guy Levecher and Stuart Lennox; negotiation report, not final sentencing order.

gp-jail.label: Greenpeace e.V., July 19, 2001: foreign defendants still jailed after July 14 arrest, in Bakersfield. Full indexed press-release text reviewed; original now returns 410.

gp-bail.label: Greenpeace e.V., July 20, 2001: bail authorized for nine foreign defendants; Indian defendant still held over passport issue. Authorization is not treated as actual release date.

british-custody.label: Steve Boggan, Independent, July 17, 2001: Morgan, Nandris and Wills held after July 14 protest and awaiting release.

australian-custody.label: Tanya Nolan, ABC The World Today, July 23, 2001: Nick Clyde and Stuart Lennox spent about a week in US jail and were released before interview.

journalists-custody.label: Reporters Committee for Freedom of the Press, February 7, 2002: Stephen Morgan eight days and Jorge Torres about four days in jail; all seventeen accepted misdemeanor conspiracy-to-trespass plea.

journalists-release.label: Reporters Without Borders annual report 2002, United States: July 14 arrest; Torres bail release July 17 and Morgan five days later. Reporting roles distinguished from activists.

eriksson-release.label: Sveriges Radio P4 Sormland, July 22, 2001: Patrik Eriksson released yesterday on bail after a week in custody. Only Eriksson assigned that exact day.

eriksson-jail.label: Magnus Sundholm, Aftonbladet, July 19, 2001: Patrik Eriksson still held in Lerdo, Bakersfield; delayed bail. Reported ages conflict elsewhere and are not used for birth year.

nazareth-release.label: Aunohita Mazumdar, Times of India, November 2, 2001: confirms Samir Nazareth released following consular assistance; exact day unspecified.

bail-status.label: Duncan Campbell, Guardian, August 15, 2001: confirms all defendants on bail by this report. Used only to establish release year, not precise day.

prisoner.name: Nic Clyde
prisoner.description: Nic Clyde was a Australian Greenpeace participant jailed in California following the 2001 Vandenberg anti-missile protest.

cases.charges: Conspiracy to trespass — misdemeanor plea following Vandenberg missile-test protest
cases.sentence: About a week in jail; bail release confirmed by July 23 interview. A 2002 misdemeanor plea resolved the felony prosecution. Post-release travel restrictions and probation are not jail time.
